hints.title: Asynchronous Invocation Transformation
hints.text: Wrap the asynchronous invocation inside a deferred construct that handles completion through resolve and reject triggers.

hints.title: Callback Appending Strategy
hints.text: Return an asynchronous wrapper function that passes a trailing callback into the target function to observe its error and data outputs.

hints.title: Promise Settlement Blueprint
hints.text: Inside new Promise, invoke fn(...args, (err, data) => err ? reject(err) : resolve(data)).

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: number of arguments passed to function
complexity.notes: Wrapper creation and promise constructor run in constant overhead time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Direct invocation without promise wrapping cannot be awaited or integrated with modern promise chains.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Allocates a single closure and promise per invocation.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Handling of error-first callback conventions where truthy error rejects and falsy resolves data.
